name: Shota Choukyou 2
source:
Meet Yuki, a pure, masochistic young boy who dresses like a girl... an innocent slave to the brutal training you will enforce!

Yuki will submit with absolute obedience to his master's every order, and will act quietly and obediently until he must carry out certain acts. However when he starts getting excited, confused and messed up, things will really start to heat up!

In the train, at the public toilets, in the convenience store... Just think of it, and let your shota fantasies begin!!!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037568.html]DLsite English[/url]]
